Head of Department (2025 — 2026) • In Memoriam

Prof. E.W. Mangset

"A father, a trainer, a teacher, a mentor, and a role model."

Prof. E.W. Mangset served devotedly as the Head of our Physics Department from 2025 until we sadly lost him in May 2026. Dedicated with love and respect by the Physics Class of 2024 in gratitude for his wonderful teaching, fatherly advice, and lasting guidance.
